tasks.title: Bulk grading and shared locked finalization
acceptance_criteria: One typed-array bulk upsert handles multiple graded answers, safely skips an empty set, collapses duplicate question IDs last-wins, and preserves nullable fields and flagged_for_review.

Student and admin submit use one transaction that locks the session before reading answers, grades that snapshot, performs one terminal CAS with score/admin flag, updates registration, inserts one CertificateNeeded event, and rolls back every step on failure.
Autosave/finalizer and competing-finalizer tests prove lock ordering, no late overwrite, one terminal winner, and no duplicate terminal side effects.
Focused repository and service Go tests pass with the required GOROOT override.

tasks.title: Durable revisioned answer deltas
acceptance_criteria: Every answer or flag edit is immediately stored as the latest per-question value with a monotonic session-local revision before debounce or dispatch.
Serialized delta requests acknowledge only the exact carried revision; older acknowledgements cannot clear or mark saved a newer revision, and failures remain durable and retryable.
Reconnect hydrates the server snapshot once, overlays and replays local revisions, and later refetches cannot clobber newer local edits.
Focused queue, hook, and exam-page frontend tests pass.

tasks.title: Fail-closed transitions and reconciliation
acceptance_criteria: Voluntary submit and section advance flush debounce, drain all revisioned deltas, and await a full valid-scope reconciliation before invoking the transition endpoint.
Any barrier failure prevents submit or advance, retains pending revisions, remains visibly unsaved, and permits retry.
Full reconciliation runs after reconnect hydration, before section boundaries, and every five active minutes; sectioned payloads include only the active section.
Focused queue, hook, and exam-page frontend tests pass.

tasks.title: Bounded server-side expiry worker
acceptance_criteria: Fixed-limit deterministic queries select only due timed standard sessions or due active timed sections using duration, extension, and grace, never scheduled_end_at or untimed sessions.
Locked revalidation atomically advances one expired non-final section or uses the shared finalizer for standard and final-section expiry, using only committed PostgreSQL answers.
Expiry races are idempotent, failures roll back candidate state, and one candidate failure does not abort later candidates or future polls.
Focused repository, service, worker, and worker-command Go tests pass with the required GOROOT override.
